note: Hand-written, scene-specific captions. Each is used once; post-photo.mjs refuses to reuse a caption hash already in content/caption-ledger.json.

captions.dinner:
Someone at this table once told me I'd never be able to pick up the bill.

I didn't argue. I wrote it down. One line, private, dated.

That line became the standard I trained against for 30 days. Tonight it was just dinner.

Step 1 of the Receipts system is that line. The template is free, link in bio.

#receipts #provethemwrong #30daychallenge #selfimprovement #consistency
captions.bills:
The receipt isn't the bill. It's what they said about you when the bills were late.

I keep both on this table now. One gets paid. The other gets proved wrong, one logged day at a time.

If money is the thing you were underestimated about, start with the free Step 1 template (link in bio). Ten minutes, no sign-up.

#receipts #moneygoals #discipline #30days #selfimprovement
